<h1 id="delegatingchatclient构建企业级-ai-中间件的利器">DelegatingChatClient:构建企业级 AI 中间件的利器</h1>
<h2 id="一句话简介">一句话简介</h2>
<p>通过 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 的 DelegatingChatClient 基类,轻松创建自定义中间件,实现限流、重试、安全过滤等企业级功能,让 AI 应用更安全、更稳定。</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="-核心价值">🎯 核心价值</h2>
<ul>
<li>✅ <strong>简单易用</strong>:只需继承基类并重写需要的方法</li>
<li>✅ <strong>灵活组合</strong>:多个中间件可以管道式串联</li>
<li>✅ <strong>企业就绪</strong>:实现限流、安全、监控等生产级功能</li>
<li>✅ <strong>标准化</strong>:遵循统一的 <code>IChatClient</code> 接口规范</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="-为什么需要自定义中间件">📝 为什么需要自定义中间件?</h2>
<p>在实际应用中,我们经常需要对 AI 服务进行增强和控制:</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>场景</th>
<th>挑战</th>
<th>中间件方案</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>API 限流</strong></td>
<td>超出调用频率限制</td>
<td>RateLimitingChatClient</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>网络故障</strong></td>
<td>临时性错误导致失败</td>
<td>RetryingChatClient</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>内容安全</strong></td>
<td>敏感信息泄露风险</td>
<td>ContentFilteringChatClient</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>性能监控</strong></td>
<td>无法追踪响应时间</td>
<td>PerformanceMonitoringClient</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>合规审计</strong></td>
<td>需要记录所有交互</td>
<td>AuditLoggingChatClient</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="️-delegatingchatclient-核心概念">🏗️ DelegatingChatClient 核心概念</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/577140/202511/577140-20251122195004374-1789724515.png" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><strong>核心特性:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>🔧 <strong>透明转发</strong>:默认将所有调用转发到内部客户端</li>
<li>🔧 <strong>可选重写</strong>:只需重写需要定制的方法</li>
<li>🔧 <strong>管道友好</strong>:支持多个中间件串联组合</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>可重写方法:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><code>GetResponseAsync</code>:处理完整响应</li>
<li><code>GetStreamingResponseAsync</code>:处理流式响应</li>
<li><code>Dispose</code>:清理资源</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="-快速开始">💻 快速开始</h2>
<h3 id="1-实现限流中间件">1. 实现限流中间件</h3>
<p>保护 API 免受过载,控制调用频率:</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">using Microsoft.Extensions.AI;
using System.Threading.RateLimiting;

public sealed class RateLimitingChatClient : DelegatingChatClient
{
    private readonly RateLimiter _rateLimiter;

    public RateLimitingChatClient(IChatClient innerClient, RateLimiter rateLimiter)
        : base(innerClient)
    {
        _rateLimiter = rateLimiter;
    }

    public override async Task&lt;ChatResponse&gt; GetResponseAsync(
        IEnumerable&lt;ChatMessage&gt; messages,
        ChatOptions? options = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // 获取限流许可
        using var lease = await _rateLimiter.AcquireAsync(1, cancellationToken);
        
        if (!lease.IsAcquired)
            throw new InvalidOperationException("请求被限流拒绝");

        // 转发到内部客户端
        return await base.GetResponseAsync(messages, options, cancellationToken);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用方式:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var limiter = new ConcurrencyLimiter(new() { PermitLimit = 2 });
var client = new RateLimitingChatClient(baseClient, limiter);
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="2-实现安全过滤中间件">2. 实现安全过滤中间件</h3>
<p>过滤敏感信息,保护数据安全:</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public sealed class ContentFilteringChatClient : DelegatingChatClient
{
    private readonly HashSet&lt;string&gt; _sensitiveWords;

    public ContentFilteringChatClient(
        IChatClient innerClient, 
        IEnumerable&lt;string&gt; sensitiveWords)
        : base(innerClient)
    {
        _sensitiveWords = new HashSet&lt;string&gt;(
            sensitiveWords, 
            StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }

    public override async Task&lt;ChatResponse&gt; GetResponseAsync(
        IEnumerable&lt;ChatMessage&gt; messages,
        ChatOptions? options = null,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        // 过滤输入消息
        var filteredMessages = FilterMessages(messages);
        
        // 调用底层客户端
        return await base.GetResponseAsync(
            filteredMessages, 
            options, 
            cancellationToken);
    }

    private List&lt;ChatMessage&gt; FilterMessages(IEnumerable&lt;ChatMessage&gt; messages)
    {
        return messages.Select(m =&gt; 
        {
            if (m.Text != null &amp;&amp; ContainsSensitiveWords(m.Text))
            {
                return new ChatMessage(m.Role, MaskSensitiveWords(m.Text));
            }
            return m;
        }).ToList();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="3-使用-chatclientbuilderuse-简化开发">3. 使用 ChatClientBuilder.Use 简化开发</h3>
<p>除了继承 <code>DelegatingChatClient</code>,还可以使用内联方式:</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var client = baseClient.AsBuilder()
    // 添加日志中间件
    .Use(async (messages, options, innerClient, cancellationToken) =&gt;
    {
        Console.WriteLine($"[日志] 收到 {messages.Count()} 条消息");
        var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        
        var response = await innerClient.GetResponseAsync(
            messages, options, cancellationToken);
        
        Console.WriteLine($"[日志] 耗时: {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");
        return response;
    })
    // 添加重试中间件
    .Use(async (messages, options, innerClient, cancellationToken) =&gt;
    {
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; 3; i++)
        {
            try
            {
                return await innerClient.GetResponseAsync(
                    messages, options, cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (Exception ex) when (i &lt; 2)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($"[重试] 第 {i + 1} 次失败,准备重试...");
                await Task.Delay(1000 * (i + 1));
            }
        }
        throw new Exception("重试失败");
    })
    .Build();
</code></pre>
<p><strong>优势对比:</strong></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>方式</th>
<th>适用场景</th>
<th>优势</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>继承方式</strong></td>
<td>复杂逻辑、资源管理</td>
<td>完全控制、可复用</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>内联方式</strong></td>
<td>简单场景、快速开发</td>
<td>代码简洁、灵活</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<hr>
<h2 id="-创建可复用扩展方法">🔧 创建可复用扩展方法</h2>
<p>将中间件封装为扩展方法,提高复用性:</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public static class ChatClientExtensions
{
    public static ChatClientBuilder UseRateLimiting(
        this ChatClientBuilder builder,
        RateLimiter rateLimiter)
    {
        return builder.Use(innerClient =&gt; 
            new RateLimitingChatClient(innerClient, rateLimiter));
    }

    public static ChatClientBuilder UseContentFiltering(
        this ChatClientBuilder builder,
        IEnumerable&lt;string&gt; sensitiveWords)
    {
        return builder.Use(innerClient =&gt; 
            new ContentFilteringChatClient(innerClient, sensitiveWords));
    }

    public static ChatClientBuilder UsePerformanceMonitoring(
        this ChatClientBuilder builder)
    {
        return builder.Use(async (messages, options, innerClient, ct) =&gt;
        {
            var sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            var response = await innerClient.GetResponseAsync(messages, options, ct);
            Console.WriteLine($"[性能] {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}ms");
            return response;
        });
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用扩展方法:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var client = baseClient.AsBuilder()
    .UsePerformanceMonitoring()
    .UseContentFiltering(new[] { "密码", "账号" })
    .UseRateLimiting(rateLimiter)
    .Build();
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="-企业级最佳实践">🏢 企业级最佳实践</h2>
<h3 id="1-中间件执行顺序洋葱模型">1. 中间件执行顺序(洋葱模型)</h3>
<pre><code>请求: 外层 → 内层 → AI 模型
响应: AI 模型 → 内层 → 外层
</code></pre>
<p><strong>推荐顺序:</strong></p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>层级</th>
<th>中间件类型</th>
<th>原因</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>最外层</td>
<td>日志、监控</td>
<td>记录所有请求和响应</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>中间层</td>
<td>安全过滤</td>
<td>在消耗资源前拦截</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>内层</td>
<td>限流、缓存</td>
<td>减少 API 调用</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>示例配置:</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var client = baseClient.AsBuilder()
    .UsePerformanceMonitoring()  // 外层:监控
    .UseContentFiltering(words)  // 中层:安全
    .UseRateLimiting(limiter)    // 内层:限流
    .Build();
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="2-处理流式和非流式响应">2. 处理流式和非流式响应</h3>
<p>需要同时支持两种模式:</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// 非流式响应
public override async Task&lt;ChatResponse&gt; GetResponseAsync(...)
{
    var response = await base.GetResponseAsync(...);
    ProcessFullContent(response.Text);
    return response;
}

// 流式响应
public override async IAsyncEnumerable&lt;ChatResponseUpdate&gt; 
    GetStreamingResponseAsync(...)
{
    StringBuilder accumulated = new();
    await foreach (var update in base.GetStreamingResponseAsync(...))
    {
        accumulated.Append(update.Text);
        yield return update;
    }
    ProcessFullContent(accumulated.ToString());
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h3 id="3-资源管理和生命周期">3. 资源管理和生命周期</h3>
<p>正确实现资源释放:</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public sealed class MyCustomChatClient : DelegatingChatClient
{
    private readonly IDisposable _resource;
    
    protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
    {
        if (disposing)
        {
            _resource?.Dispose();
        }
        base.Dispose(disposing);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>最佳实践:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 始终调用 <code>base.Dispose(disposing)</code></li>
<li>✅ 在 <code>disposing == true</code> 时释放托管资源</li>
<li>✅ 使用 <code>using</code> 语句确保释放</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h3 id="4-依赖注入集成">4. 依赖注入集成</h3>
<p>在 ASP.NET Core 中使用:</p>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">// Program.cs
builder.Services.AddSingleton&lt;RateLimiter&gt;(_ =&gt; 
    new ConcurrencyLimiter(new() { PermitLimit = 10 }));

builder.Services.AddChatClient(services =&gt;
{
    var baseClient = /* 创建基础客户端 */;
    
    return baseClient
        .AsBuilder()
        .UsePerformanceMonitoring()
        .UseContentFiltering(new[] { "敏感词" })
        .UseRateLimiting(services.GetRequiredService&lt;RateLimiter&gt;())
        .Build();
});

// 在服务中注入使用
public class MyService
{
    private readonly IChatClient _chatClient;
    
    public MyService(IChatClient chatClient)
    {
        _chatClient = chatClient;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="-总结">🎯 总结</h2>
<ul>
<li>✅ <strong>三种实现方式</strong>:继承 DelegatingChatClient、Use 内联、扩展方法</li>
<li>✅ <strong>常见场景</strong>:限流、安全、监控、重试、审计</li>
<li>✅ <strong>洋葱模型</strong>:外层监控、中层安全、内层限流</li>
<li>✅ <strong>生产就绪</strong>:资源管理、依赖注入、错误处理</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>选择建议:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>💻 复杂逻辑、需要资源管理 → 继承 DelegatingChatClient</li>
<li>💻 简单场景、快速开发 → Use 内联方式</li>
<li>💻 可复用组件 → 扩展方法</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>下一步:</strong> 探索 MEAI ChatClient中间件和Function Invoker的区别</p>
